title: Thalai Nagaram
desc: After Right, a petty criminal, kills Bhai's son, Bhai's gangsters seek revenge by killing Right's friend Balu. Later, Right decides to lead a normal life, but a corrupt police officer exploits him.

title: Jee
desc: Vasu aspires to contest in the college elections but is forced to let go because of a politician's son. However, when the latter's goons harass him, he vows to stand up for himself.

title: Marumagan
desc: Thangarasu, a humble tailor, falls for Manjula, the daughter of a corrupt politician. Subsequently, her mother opposes their love while her father seeks to exploit their relationship for his own gain.

title: Urumi
desc: Kelu is a warrior in 16th century Kerala whose father was killed by Vasco da Gama and his troops. Kelu vows to avenge his father's death with the assistance of Vavvali and Ayesha, a warrior princess.

title: Thotti Jaya
desc: An orphan named Thotti Jaya is hired by a mobster after he is spotted thrashing a dishonest man. However, his troubles begin when he falls in love with his boss' daughter.
